recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast macro photograph of a spherical red powder puff flower (Calliandra) centered on a horizontal horizon line. The top half features the vibrant red flower against a solid black background, while the bottom half shows its dark, detailed reflection on a warm, tan-colored surface, creating a symmetrical hourglass-like form.
coreVisualRelationships: Symmetry between the physical object and its reflection across a central horizon.
Chromatic tension between the saturated red filaments and the stark black-and-tan background.
Geometric contrast between the organic, fibrous sphere and the rigid, rectangular typographic framing.
coreInvariants: Spherical red fibrous flower as the central subject.
Horizontal split background: black top, tan bottom.
Perfect vertical reflection of the subject.
Top and bottom centered typographic boxes.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The flower is perfectly centered, occupying approximately 60% of the vertical height.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central core of the flower where the filaments converge.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the bright red sphere, follows the reflection downward, and is then caught by the mirrored typographic blocks at the extreme top and bottom edges.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Large areas of flat color (black and tan) provide breathing room for the intricate texture of the flower.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Vibrant Crimson Red for the subject filaments.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep Matte Black for the upper background and shadows.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Warm Tan/Beige for the lower reflective surface.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the subject against low-saturation, high-contrast background values.

characterSpecificRedesigns: Extreme letter spacing (tracking) to fill a rectangular container.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface used in mirrored orientations.
graphicDevices: Thin white rectangular border surrounding the text blocks.
180-degree rotation for the bottom text block to mimic the reflection.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the wide, technical, geometric feel of the era.
Provides the necessary square proportions and clean lines.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Photograph a red Calliandra flower centered on a horizon line where the top half is pitch black and the bottom half is a reflective tan surface. Ensure the reflection is sharp and symmetrical.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a small black rectangle with a thin white border at the top center and bottom center. Inside each, place uppercase geometric sans-serif text with extreme letter spacing. Rotate the bottom box and text 180 degrees.

verificationChecks: Is the flower perfectly centered on the horizon?
Is the bottom text block rotated 180 degrees?
Is the tracking wide enough to span the width of the container?
Is the color palette strictly red, black, and tan?

mustRedesign: Unique imperfections in the original print

mustAchieve: High-fidelity macro texture in the flower filaments

postGenerationChecks: Check for 180-degree rotation of the bottom text.
Verify the horizon line bisects the flower sphere.
Ensure the red filaments are vibrant and distinct.
Confirm the typography is contained within bordered boxes.
recipe.reuseFormula: Macro botanical subject + horizontal split background (Dark/Light) + mirrored reflection + mirrored geometric typography in boxes.
